messages:
Alex_Sales: Kicking off this thread — final POC with Echelon Bank wrapped. Need a compact set of bullets for the customer readout slides (metrics + next steps).
Priya_SE: Quick reminder of scope: invoice/receipt extraction + intent classification + fraud-alert reranker. Success criteria we agreed: extractor EM >= 95%, intent acc >= 97%, reranker NDCG@10 >= 0.85, 95th latency < 200ms, and estimated unit cost <= $0.015/token at projected volume.
Mateo_SRE: From dedicated-run logs: median latency 120ms, 95th 230ms at the POC traffic profile (KV cache warmed). Batching increased throughput; attached sample logs in the deck.
Jordan_Solution: Eval summary (prompt set v3): extractor EM 93.4% (below target), intent 98.2%, reranker NDCG@10 0.81. Detailed per-field breakdown in the eval tab.
Samira_PM: Main gap is extractor EM — OCR noise on receipts is the likely culprit. Proposed mitigations: add 200 labeled receipt examples, apply post-extract regex normalization for currency/date, and try model v2 for extraction.
Ben_RevenueOps: Pricing question from Echelon: they'd like committed-capacity pricing for a 6-month pilot with option to expand. Ballpark committed discount tiers ready but engineering needs to confirm the cost multiplier for dedicated GPUs under burst.
Priya_SE: Security checklist update: customer sent SQA + SCCM. They require KMS/HSM details and SOC2 attestation. If they insist on private deployment we hit an extra 4–8 week onboarding window.
Alex_Sales: Can the team help assemble two concise slides for tomorrow 10:00am readout (1) topline metrics vs targets, (2) gaps + remediation + recommended commercial ask? Also need a one-paragraph expansion ask for their execs.
Mateo_SRE: We can pull the SOC2 summary and KMS diagram from our private deployment docs. On-prem appliance would add ~4 weeks; VPC-hosted private is closer to 6 weeks depending on their networking.
Jordan_Solution: Recommended technical plan for readout: propose a canary rollout for extractor v2 at 20% traffic with automatic fallback. Eval prompt example to show on slide:

```
Prompt: "Extract vendor, invoice_date, total_amount from invoice_text: {text}"
Output schema: {vendor:string, invoice_date:YYYY-MM-DD, total_amount:decimal}
```

Use eval harness id: eval-2026-05-invoice for reproducibility.
Samira_PM: Action items (owner): Priya — assemble slide with metrics + top3 gaps + mitigation steps; Mateo — attach SOC2 & KMS diagram; Ben — draft committed pricing tiers and conservative capacity estimate; Jordan — include canary rollout plan and eval snippet; Alex — run the readout. I'll own follow-ups and customer agenda. :thumbsup:
Alex_Sales: Perfect. I'll invite Echelon (cc: @maria_corp) to tomorrow 10am and send the internal slide deck after our sync. Thanks everyone — short and focused please. :rocket:
